weapon.d: Grants Spd+3. Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X during combat. (Calculates X based on number of allies within 2 spaces of unit: 0 allies grants +5; 1 grants +3; 2 grants +1; ≥3 allies grants +0.) If the number of allies within 2 spaces is ≤ 1, inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack during combat. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.) If foe's Range = 2, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+6 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+7 during combat.

b.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.
Neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Def+2 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Def+4 to unit for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Def+6 to unit for 1 turn.
